summary: Sagimet Biosciences Inc. filed an 8-K on April 21, 2026, reporting the retirement of Chief Medical Officer Eduardo Martins, M.D., D.Phil., effective April 20, 2026, and the immediate appointment of Andreas Grauer, M.D. as his replacement. Dr. Grauer most recently served as CMO at Omeros Corporation. The changes are effective as of April 20, 2026, with Dr. Martins remaining as an external scientific advisor. No financial terms, board recommendations, or advisors are disclosed. The filing is an Item 5.02 departure/appointment announcement, not tied to any broader event. Watch for any future strategic impacts from this senior personnel transition, though no risk-arb angle exists.
